translations.web: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
translations.bsb: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
translations.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
translations.asv: He was the lamp that burneth and shineth; and ye were willing to rejoice for a season in his light.
